name: Coffee C
read: Coffee C Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 274.9, 86 days to expiry 2027-02-10): at-the-money implied vol 35.8%, -2.6 pts vs 2026-11-10. 20-day realized vol 24.4%, so options trade at a premium of 11.4 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +1.1 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-11-03 to 2026-11-16) call open interest fell 39,468 and puts fell 78,391; put/call OI 1.43 → 1.12, front futures 274.6 → 274.9. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +865 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 39.5% → 35.8%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 300 calls (2,936 lots) and 250 puts (4,793). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 250 puts +1,114; Mar 27 285 calls +1,013. Biggest cut: Mar 27 330 calls -459.
